How to use this tool

  1. Select your files or try a sample.
  2. Review the pages and choose the changes you need.
  3. Process locally, then download or continue with another tool.

A few things to know

PDF processing supports up to 30 MiB and 150 pages per task. Password-protected and damaged files are not supported. Check your output before sharing.

Files are kept in tab memory only. Closing or refreshing this page clears your workspace. Keep a copy of your originals.

Merge PDFs in a deliberate order

A combined PDF follows the file order in the workspace, not the dates printed inside the documents. Put a cover letter first, then supporting documents, and check the page count before downloading. The up and down controls work without dragging, including with a keyboard.

Merging copies pages into a new document. Bookmarks, interactive forms and digital signatures may not survive as expected. Keep the source files and inspect the result in a separate PDF reader. For a signed contract, use the signer’s approved workflow rather than merging a signed copy.

Saving your result

Use Download after processing. If it does not start, use Save as where available, or Open file and save from your browser’s viewer. Inside an embedded preview, open the full website in a browser tab before selecting your files. Troubleshoot a download.
